cards.text: Every last piece of the tabernacle is done. Moses, Israel's leader, inspects all the work, sees it's just as the LORD commanded, and blesses the people. Then the LORD speaks to Moses again.

cards.question: The tabernacle is built, but it's all still in pieces. When does the LORD say Moses should set it up?

answers.text: On the first day of the first month
On the seventh day of the seventh month
On the tenth day of the first month

cards.text: Into the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, goes the ark of the Testimony. That's piece one of the biggest assembly job I've ever heard of, and I can't put together a cooling rack without THREE screws left over.

cards.question: The ark of the Testimony goes into the tabernacle. True or false: the LORD tells Moses to leave the ark out in the open where anyone can see it.

cards.text: In go the table and the lampstand with its lamps. Then the gold altar of incense goes in front of the ark, and a curtain hangs at the entrance to the tabernacle.

cards.question: Next up is the altar of burnt offering. Where does the LORD tell Moses to place it?

answers.text: In front of the tabernacle entrance
Behind the veil beside the ark
Inside the Tent next to the table

cards.text: Then the basin goes between the Tent of Meeting and the altar. Every piece gets its exact spot, and the last time somebody picked MY spot, it was the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: The basin sits between the Tent of Meeting and the altar. The LORD tells Moses to put ___ in it.

cards.text: The courtyard goes up around it all, with a curtain for its entrance. Then Moses is to take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it. EVERYTHING, friend.

cards.question: Once Moses anoints and consecrates the tabernacle and all its furnishings, the LORD says it shall be ___.
Moses is to anoint the altar of burnt offering and its utensils too. True or false: the LORD says that altar will be most holy.

cards.text: The basin and its stand get anointed too. That's the furniture, and now the LORD gets to the people: Aaron, Moses' brother, and his sons, brought to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

cards.question: Aaron and his sons are standing at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. True or false: the LORD tells Moses to anoint them before he washes them with water.
Moses is to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him and consecrate him. Why?

answers.text: So he may serve the LORD as a priest
So he may lead Israel into battle
So he may judge the people's disputes

cards.text: Then Aaron's sons come forward and get tunics. Moses is to anoint them just like he anointed their father, so they can serve the LORD as priests too.

cards.question: The anointing qualifies Aaron's sons for the priesthood. How long does the LORD say that priesthood will last?

cards.text: The LORD gave the orders, and now it's GO time. Moses does everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.question: The tabernacle goes up on the first day of the first month of the ___ year.

cards.text: Moses lays the bases, sets the frames, slides in the crossbars and puts up the posts. Then the tent goes over the tabernacle and the covering goes over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.question: With the tent up, Moses places the Testimony in the ark and attaches its poles. What does he set on top of the ark?

cards.text: He brings the ark into the tabernacle. Up goes the veil, and the ark is shielded off, just as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.question: Moses puts the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side, outside the veil. What does he arrange on it before the LORD?
Now for the lampstand. True or false: Moses sets the lampstand right beside the table on the north side.

cards.text: He sets up the lamps, then burns fragrant incense on the gold altar in front of the veil, just as the LORD had commanded him. That line again, and me? I skimmed a recipe ONE time and pulled out a cookie the size of a hubcap.

cards.question: Moses hangs the curtain at the entrance and places the altar of burnt offering near it. What does he offer on that altar?

answers.text: The burnt offering and the grain offering
The burnt offering and the drink offering
The burnt offering and the sin offering

cards.text: Then the basin goes between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, with water in it for washing. Washing up? Friend, with this mustache, that's a two-towel job.

cards.question: Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons wash their ___ and ___ at the basin.
True or false: Moses, Aaron and his sons wash at the basin just once, on the day the tabernacle goes up.

cards.text: Last of all, Moses sets up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar and hangs the curtain at its entrance. So Moses finished the work.

cards.question: The work is finished. Then what covers the Tent of Meeting?

cards.text: The cloud covers the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD fills the tabernacle. Take a breath right here, friend.

cards.question: True or false: Moses walks right into the Tent of Meeting while the cloud is settled on it.
From here on, whenever the cloud lifts from above the tabernacle, what do the Israelites do?

answers.text: They set out on their journey
They stay put until it settles
They gather to hear Moses speak

cards.text: And if the cloud doesn't lift, they don't set out until the day it does. No cloud moving, no people moving, and I can't even wait out a twelve-minute oven timer.

cards.question: By day, the cloud of the LORD is over the tabernacle. By night, there is ___ in the cloud.

cards.text: Fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, through all their journeys. Back in that drawer, friend, I'd have given anything for a light like that.

findings.problem: Exodus 40:3-8 is the LORD's placement plan for the tabernacle: ark, veil, table, lampstand, gold altar, entrance curtain, altar of burnt offering, basin and courtyard. It is building-plan detail, but it gets story cards 3, 5 and 7 plus choice cards 4, 6 and 8, instead of one summary story card.

rule.text: A long stretch never gets a choice card.

findings.problem: Exodus 40:18-33 is a repeated report: Moses carries out the same placement plan from 40:3-8, piece by piece. It gets many story cards (3, 5, 8, 10, 13) and choice cards about furniture details (4 mercy seat, 6 bread, 7 lampstand side, 9 grain offering, 11 hands and feet, 12 washing), instead of one summary story card. That card could keep a standout detail like the repeated "just as the LORD had commanded him."

rule.text: A long stretch never gets a choice card.

findings.problem: Most of stop 2's choice cards are pure discovery that no earlier card sets up: card 2 (second year), card 4 (mercy seat), card 6 (bread), card 7 (lampstand on the south side), card 9 (grain offering) and card 11 (hands and feet). That is about half the stop's choice cards.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

findings.problem: In stop 1, the LORD is only giving instructions (40:1-15), and Moses doesn't carry them out until 40:16-33. But cards 3, 5, 7 and 9 tell the instructions as things already happening ("goes the ark," "In go the table and the lampstand," "the basin goes," "The courtyard goes up"). That reads as if the setup is being done, which the text shows comes later.

rule.text: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The story card has three sentences: "The courtyard goes up... Then Moses is to take the anointing oil... EVERYTHING, friend."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Nothing on the earlier cards hints at whether washing or anointing comes first, so this true or false question is a 50/50 guess on the order.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: The statement is about anointing both Aaron and his sons ("anoint them"). The sons' anointing is in 40:15, but the card cites only Exodus 40:12-13.

rule.text: A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer. After a pick, the baker sees the reference, whether they were right or wrong.

findings.problem: The story card has three sentences: "He sets up the lamps... commanded him." "That line again, and me?" "I skimmed a recipe..."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card carries three moments of the passage: the lamps set up (40:25), the gold altar placed in front of the veil (40:26) and the incense burned (40:27). The joke comes on top of those.

rule.text: Aim for one beat per story card. Two is the most. If a story card has more than two things happening, split it.

findings.problem: The story card has three sentences: "Then the basin goes... for washing." "Washing up?" "Friend, with this mustache, that's a two-towel job."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The right answer, "The cloud," is the only one with "The," which makes it sound like something already known. The wrong answers both start with "A" ("A heavy hail," "A great wind"), so the right answer stands out.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
